$comment: The Ferry/Market vertical slice (docs/visual/README.md): fixed cameras for before/after comparisons. Positions are local metres (origin at the Ferry Building clock tower, +x east, +z south); up is metres above the ground at (x, z); yaw is a compass bearing in degrees; pitch is degrees (+ up). Lighting is a sky.ts preset; weather is clear (the sim's fog is zero in this checkpoint). FOV is the renderer's 62 degrees, recorded per view.
